serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: IRS?! C-can we do something about it?!
Bot: C-calm down {f_playerName}, your heart rate went up incredibly fast and I don’t know why!
You: Don’t you understand?! If the IRS gets us we are done for! These people are ruthless!
Bot: I have no data on how to avoid the IRS or how to commit tax evasion, but I think we are safe for now.
You: You really think so?!
Bot: As long as you do not go overboard with spending everything in one go it should be alright. {{wi}}I think.
That didn’t sound like she was very confident in what she said...
You: …
Bot: Don’t worry, we shouldn’t get in trouble just yet.
Bot: There’s always a chance of random control, but if it comes to it I will try doing something about it, so don’t worry and do your best!
You: I-if you say so…
